# Where do the new cells come from?

<!-- STEP id="looking-back" -->
## A plant keeps growing

Plant and animal tissues differ in support, in food, in carrying materials and in growth. A plant keeps growing all its life, even though most of its cells are specialised and no longer divide.

<!-- STEP id="growth-question" -->
## The next question

A neem seedling becomes a tall tree, its roots go deeper and its trunk grows thicker.

**Where in the plant are the dividing cells that make the new cells for this growth?**
